gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Wide, loud and confident: Goldman stretches out with round shapes like open parentheses, while Noto Sans Glagolitic stays sturdy underneath. Choose a modest size for the sans-serif text and it stays legible.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Noto Sans Gothic is modern and open, with lowercase counters as big as drilled glass beads. Noto Sans Gothic gives Goldman, wide and commanding up top, a quiet partner below.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha is tall and tidy, with little bowls pressed flat. Goldman announces things loudly up top, and over a full page of text the body never snags on a closed-up bowl.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gond: Wide-set and round like open parentheses, Goldman leads. Against that, Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi brings crayon-tall lowercase strokes and terminals cut back to leave a big gap, which is the pair's whole charm.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Wide spacing and a big lowercase give Goldman its swagger. Noto Sans Gurmukhi, a tidy sans with tong-like outward terminals, speaks quietly exactly where the heading shouts, and that split is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Noto Sans Hanunoo fills most of the line height with open terminals. Goldman can be as loud as it likes up top, since this neutral, contemporary sans-serif keeps the text legible and plain.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Wide and brash: Goldman stretches out in round shapes, while Noto Sans Hebrew packs a dominant midsection. Goldman makes the statement; this sans keeps wide gaps between curves and stems.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-hk: Commanding and wide-set, Goldman delivers display punch in round, parenthesis-like forms. And Noto Sans HK, a sans-serif with large lowercase forms and lifted brush ends, handles the finer reading work.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-imperial-ara: Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic is approachable and professional, with the c's two ends pointing apart like open pincers. Goldman delivers the wide, bold statement; the plain sans handles the reading.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-inscriptiona: Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian reads clean, with big open eyes on e and a and a deep middle band. And Goldman, wide and commanding, takes the display work while the sans-serif body quietly carries the reading.
